name: Displacer Beast
sourceVersion: v2 text with original folio parallel check
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra, published on DMs Guild for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Both player trait blocks use 30 ft. walking speed and omit darkvision. The Design Notes discuss 35 ft. and darkvision.
Tentacle attacks use ordinary 5-ft. reach. When rolling mixed damage, the build applies the single Strength bonus to bludgeoning.

name: Dragon Turtle
sourceVersion: v2 text with original folio parallel check
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra, published on DMs Guild for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
sourceDistinctions: Both player versions omit the save ability for the creature caught in the steam. Constitution is the explicit table ruling and follows the matching 2014 Steam Breath save type.
The finished trait block gives neither darkvision nor fire resistance even though the Design Notes mention both. It also omits amphibious breathing. The build follows the trait block.

name: Mimic
page: p. 146, Mimic Traits, v2. Original trait folio p. 142.
sourceVersion: v2 text with original folio parallel check
provenance: Player conversion by Tyler Kamstra, published on DMs Guild for the 2014 fifth-edition rules.
relatedFolio: Monks and Natural Weapons, v2 p. 7
sourceDistinctions: The player trait block omits darkvision, acid resistance, and prone immunity discussed in Design Notes.
The supplement requires Martial Arts and Flurry of Blows bonus attacks to be conventional unarmed strikes. Latch uses a blunt body check, with no natural-weapon dice.
False Appearance is read as concentration during the one-minute setup. It still requires continued motionlessness after setup.
The build applies the single Strength damage bonus to the bite's piercing damage. It uses the specific Huge limit for Adhesive and ordinary grapple size for the pseudopod bonus action.
